source_facts: The Index level is calculated on each Calculation Day.
The calculation runs from 1:00 a.m. to 10:50 p.m. CET.
The calculation uses Trading Prices on the Exchanges where Index Components are listed.
Non-index-currency Trading Prices are converted using the current ICE spot foreign exchange rate.
If no current Trading Price exists, the later of the most recent Closing Price or last available Trading Price is used.
A closing Index level is also calculated for each Calculation Day.
The closing level uses Closing Prices on the relevant Exchanges.
Non-index-currency Closing Prices are converted using the 4:00 p.m. London WM Fixing quoted by Reuters.
If no 4:00 p.m. London WM Fixing exists, the last available fixing is used.
render_facts: Intraday calculations are performed on each calculation day.
Intraday calculations run from 1:00 a.m. CET to 10:50 p.m. CET.
The intraday level is calculated for that day and time.
For each index component in an intraday calculation, the source price is an exchange trading price.
The exchange must be one where the component is listed.
If a current trading price is available, it is used as the source price.
Otherwise, the source price is the later of the most recent closing price and the last available trading price from the preceding trading day.
If the component is listed in the index currency, the intraday calculation price equals the source price.
Otherwise, it is converted using the current ICE spot foreign exchange rate.
The closing level is calculated on each calculation day using closing prices.
The closing level uses the 4:00 p.m. London WM fixing or the last available such fixing.
The same currency treatment applies to the closing level.
